Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:44355: dovecot security update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
Dovecot is an IMAP server for Linux and other UNIX-like systems, written primarily with security in mind. It also contains a small POP3 server, and supports e-mail in either the maildir or mbox format. The SQL drivers and authentication plug-ins are provided as subpackages. 

Security Fix(es):

* dovecot: Dovecot: Denial of Service via excessive IMAP bracing (CVE-2026-42006)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

Criterions.Comment: Red Hat Enterprise Linux must be installed
Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 is installed
dovecot is signed with Red Hat redhatrelease2 key
